summary: Unlinks a node from a doubly linked list: if the node has a predecessor (a2[11]) its next pointer is set to the successor (a2[12]); if it has a successor its previous pointer is set to the predecessor; if the node is the list head (this[70] at offset 0x118) the head is advanced to the successor. Then runs a cleanup callback, a stub, and frees the node, returning 0.

operations.description: Read the predecessor node pointer a2[11]; if non-null proceed to link it forward
Set the predecessor's next pointer (at prev+48) to the successor node a2[12]
Read the successor node pointer a2[12]; if non-null proceed to link it backward
Set the successor's previous pointer (at next+44) to the predecessor node a2[11]
If the removed node is the list head stored at offset 0x118, advance the head
Set the head pointer this[70] at offset 0x118 to the successor node a2[12]
Run the cleanup callback CallWrapperReturning0 before deletion
Invoke EmptyStub_7470 on the node before freeing
Deallocate the node memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf
